segments.title: Fallout 4: Chet's Irradiated Rampage
segments.notes: Case Blackwell roleplays as Chet Manscape in a Fallout 4 melee build playthrough; Snap Camera presets lost; Hype Train triggers from 20 gifted subs; Kendelle appears on camera and takes controls; Def Jam: Fight for NY tournament announced for next week.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Hosts Fallout 4 gameplay stream as Chet Manscape; manages technical issues and Hype Train overlay; announces Def Jam tournament.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Persona adopted by Case for Fallout 4 melee run; high intelligence/strength build; 'possessed' by Hype Train during sub surge.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: neural co-host. Referenced as still active despite Snap Camera reset; provides off-screen commentary.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Makes secret pre-stream appearance; later appears on camera (encrypted/blurred) and takes controls for a kill.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Triggered by 20 gifted subs; 'possesses' Chet's body for freestyle rap segment; Case forgot to open alert window.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Referenced as station authority; not heard live this broadcast.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Referenced via 'who's in the wall' chat callback; not seen on screen.

storylines.beat: [02:20:52] Def Jam: Fight for NY community goal crushed; underground tournament planned for next week with PCSX2 setup.

lore_notes.fact: Snap Camera reset erased all presets; library must be rebuilt from scratch.
Kendelle makes secret appearance in pre-stream footage.
Radion V gifts 20 tier-1 subs, triggering Hype Train.
Case created Hype Train graphic but forgot to open the alert window.
Hype Train 'possesses' Chet's body during gameplay freestyle.
Chat references Peter Gibbon in the wall: 'What's in the wall? Who's in the wall?'
Kendelle appears on camera (encrypted/auto-blurred) and scores a kill.
Case experimenting with Twitch-responsive graphic integrations for potential D&D stream.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell broadcasts a Fallout 4 session roleplaying as Chet Manscape, overcoming a Snap Camera preset loss and a surprise Hype Train triggered by 20 gifted subs. Kendelle appears on camera for a brief gameplay takeover. The stream closes with the Def Jam: Fight for NY community goal met and an underground tournament announced for next week, followed by a raid on Pixel Circus.
